name: neus-mcp
description: Connect your assistant to verified identity, scoped permissions, and reusable portable proofs.

interface.shortDescription: Portable trust for any agent, editor, server, or API. Identity, permissions, proofs, and Vault.
interface.longDescription: NEUS gives any agent, editor, server, or API the same portable identity, permissions, proofs, context, and Vault. Verify once. Carry the proof. Enforce before action. For servers, CI, or automation, use the public CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use NEUS to verify identity and permissions before taking action.
Use NEUS to verify proofs for this wallet or organization.
